title: 学习指南：教学设计与探究活动
Learning guide: teaching and investigations
lead: 面向教师与学生，用十一项探究活动学习太阳、昼夜、日影、月相、日行迹和空间关系。每项任务说明问题、控制条件、操作、证据、解释与评价。

For teachers and students: eleven investigations into the Sun, day and night, shadows, lunar phases, the analemma and spatial relationships. Each states its question, controls, procedure, evidence, explanation and assessment.

text: 开始操作时，在顶部选择太阳或月球；打开左侧“视图与布局”，展开“天空与日影”选择空间、俯视、地平或仰望视角。选择其他图解后仍可从同一目录返回天空图。地点、日期与时刻在各图间共享；进入自定义只启用编辑工具，不替代原来的观测控制。

To begin, choose Sun or Moon in the top selector. Open Views & layout on the left, then expand Sky & shadows to choose spatial, plan, horizon or look-up views. Return to the sky diagram through the same catalog after choosing another diagram. Location, date and time are shared; customization enables editing tools while retaining the original observation controls.
本指南面向教师组织课堂和学生自主探究。先提出可检验的问题，再用功能手册查操作入口；每个任务都要求固定条件、改变变量、记录证据和解释结果。

This guide supports classroom teaching and independent inquiry. Start with a testable question, use the feature manual to find controls, then fix conditions, vary a quantity, record evidence and explain the outcome.

title: 实验前必须说清的四个约定
Four conventions to state before an experiment

items: 地点是实际观测条件；相机转动只改变看图方向。要移动地点，应使用经纬度、地点滑条或明确的观察点移动工具。
Location is a physical condition; rotating the camera changes only the view. Move the observer using coordinates, location sliders or the explicit observer-move tool.
高度以几何地平线为0°，天顶为90°；方位从北起顺时针，东90°、南180°、西270°。
Altitude is 0° at the geometric horizon and 90° at the zenith. Azimuth runs clockwise from north: east 90°, south 180°, west 270°.
下方当前时刻、日行迹全年采样时刻、三维UTC日期和地升地落的独立飞行控制，不应当作一个相同的钟。
The current clock, annual analemma sample clock, 3D UTC time and independent Earthrise flight controls are not one interchangeable clock.
真实日期、理想太阳赤纬实验和圆轨道地升模型的假设不同；比较结果前先写明模式。
Real-date observation, ideal solar-declination experiments and the circular Earthrise lesson have different assumptions; name the mode before comparing results.

text: 一节约四十分钟的示例
Example for an approximately forty-minute lesson

items: 导入：提出一个日常问题，让学生先预测，例如冬天正午影子是否更长。
Introduce an everyday question and collect predictions, such as whether noon shadows are longer in winter.
建模：说明地点、日期、时间依据与所用视图，演示一次只改一个量。
State place, date, time basis and views, then demonstrate changing one quantity at a time.
小组探究：分配记录者、操作者和解释者，各组用相同表格进行三个或更多对照。
Assign recorder, operator and explainer roles; use one shared worksheet for at least three comparisons.
交叉验证：要求另一张图或另一个读数支持同一解释，避免仅描述动画。
Require a second view or reading to support the explanation rather than merely describing motion.
交流与迁移：让学生解释一个新纬度、另一半球或日期变更线附近的情形。
Discuss and transfer: explain a new latitude, the opposite hemisphere or a site near the date line.
退出条：提交结论、证据、控制条件和一个模型未包含的因素。
Finish with a conclusion, evidence, controls and one factor omitted by the model.

title: 任务一：太阳一天怎样运动？
Investigation 1: How does the Sun move through a day?

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
同一天、同一地点，太阳高度和方位怎样随时刻变化？
At one place on one date, how do solar altitude and azimuth vary through the day?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
选择北京或输入约北纬40°、东经116°；选择接近北半球夏至的日期。使用日期观测，先暂停播放，保持地点和日期不变。下方日内时刻使用当地真太阳时。

Choose Beijing or approximately 40°N, 116°E and a date near the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice. Use real-date observation, pause playback and keep the place and date fixed. The daily timeline uses local apparent solar time.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 在天空与日影图选择空间视图，再加入全天高度曲线。先预测哪一时刻最高。
Open the spatial Sky & shadows view and add Daily altitude. Predict when the Sun will be highest.
Set 06:00, 09:00, 12:00, 15:00 and 18:00. Record altitude, azimuth and whether the Sun is above the horizon.
将时刻移到曲线过零附近，核对升落方位图中的事件。点击升落点可跳转事件时刻。
Move near a zero crossing of the altitude curve and check the rise/set events. Clicking an event marker jumps to its time.
播放日内时刻，观察太阳的日轨迹；暂停后用时间标记留下两个要比较的位置。
Play the daily clock and watch the diurnal path. Pause and add time markers for two positions to compare.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
太阳高度先升后降；几何地平线对应高度0°。当地真太阳时12:00对应太阳上中天，但太阳方位不应在所有地点和日期都预设为正南。
Solar altitude rises and falls, and the geometric horizon is altitude 0°. Apparent solar noon corresponds to upper culmination, but the Sun must not be assumed due south at every place and date.
怎样解释
How to explain it
日变化主要来自地球自转。轨迹是观察者天空中的视运动，不能用画面中太阳离杆子的屏幕距离推算真实日地距离。
The daily change mainly reflects Earth’s rotation. The path is apparent motion in the observer’s sky; screen distance from the Sun to a rod is not the physical Earth–Sun distance.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
用高度曲线和空间图各提供一条证据；说明为何地平线下的虚线不表示地下有一条真实轨道。
Give one piece of evidence from each view and explain why the dashed path below the horizon is not a physical underground orbit.

title: 任务二：同一地点的季节差异
Investigation 2: Seasonal changes at one place

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
为什么同一地点的正午高度、昼长和日出方位会随季节改变？
Why do noon altitude, daylight duration and sunrise direction vary seasonally at one place?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
固定同一纬度和经度；固定当地真太阳时12:00。使用真实日期。比较分日与至日附近的日期，实际分至点时刻以星历为准，不把固定公历日当作每年的精确节气。

Fix latitude, longitude and apparent solar noon. Use real dates near equinoxes and solstices. Exact event times follow the ephemeris; a fixed calendar date is not the exact seasonal instant every year.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 将地球与昼夜、全天高度曲线、升落方位和地轴与地平面放在同一工作区。
Combine Earth & daylight, Daily altitude, Rise/set bearings and Axis & horizon.
按春分、夏至、秋分、冬至的顺序设置日期；记录正午高度、日出与日落方位和昼长。
Set dates around the two equinoxes and two solstices; record noon altitude, rise/set directions and daylight duration.
用日期对照曲线保留一个季节，再调整公共日期比较另一个季节。
Keep one season as a date comparison curve, then change the shared date to compare another.
改到南半球相同绝对纬度，重复观察，并比较两半球的季节关系。
Repeat at the same absolute latitude in the Southern Hemisphere and compare seasonal patterns.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
同一地点的日轨迹会随日期上下变化，升落方向也改变。南北半球的季节变化相反；赤道、回归线和高纬地区的表现不同。
The daily path and rise/set directions change with date. Northern and Southern Hemisphere seasons are opposite; equatorial, tropical and high-latitude patterns differ.
怎样解释
How to explain it
地轴倾斜使太阳赤纬随公转变化。正午高度可用90°减去纬度与赤纬之差的绝对值解释；该式描述上中天高度，不自动给出天体位于南方还是北方。

Axial tilt produces changing solar declination through the orbit. Upper-culmination altitude follows 90° minus the absolute difference between latitude and declination; this alone does not state whether the Sun is north or south.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
解释地球与昼夜图中的直射点纬度如何与曲线峰值对应，并指出比较时必须固定哪些条件。
Connect the subsolar latitude to the curve peak and name the conditions that must remain fixed.

title: 任务三：纬度与昼夜分布
Investigation 3: Latitude and the day–night pattern

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
在相同日期，不同纬度的太阳轨迹和昼长有何差异？
How do solar paths and daylight duration differ with latitude on one date?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
固定日期和经度。先比较相同当地真太阳时，再单独研究同一UTC瞬间，避免把两种比较混在一起。
Fix date and longitude. First compare the same apparent solar clock reading; investigate a shared UTC instant separately.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 在自定义中选择同一时间、不同地点，添加赤道、中纬度和高纬地点。
Use the different-places comparison to add equatorial, middle-latitude and high-latitude sites.
明确选择固定当地真太阳时，记录三个地点的正午高度及升落情况。
Explicitly choose equal apparent solar time and record noon altitudes and rise/set behavior.
拖动一个地点的纬度滑条，观察其自动名称、曲线、位置和图例一起更新。
Scrub one site’s latitude and watch its automatic name, curve, position and legend update together.
观察出现无升落事件的高纬日期；用高度曲线判断全天在地平线上方还是下方。
Investigate a high-latitude date with no rise/set events and use the altitude curve to distinguish continuous daylight from continuous darkness.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
高纬地区可能出现极昼、极夜或地平线相切。没有事件标记不等于功能损坏；极点的正北方向也不具有唯一性。
High latitudes can produce continuous daylight, continuous darkness or a horizon tangency. Missing event markers can be valid, and geographic north is not uniquely defined at a pole.
怎样解释
How to explain it
太阳高度取决于纬度、赤纬和时角。纬度决定当地地平面相对地轴的方向，不能仅靠太阳在屏幕上的上下位置判断真实高度变化。
Altitude depends on latitude, declination and hour angle. Latitude changes the local horizon’s orientation relative to the axis; screen position alone is not an altitude measurement.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
分别写出普通升落、极昼、极夜和相切的判据，并用曲线而非只凭一帧图像说明理由。
Describe ordinary crossings, continuous daylight, continuous darkness and tangency, using the curve rather than one image as evidence.

title: 任务四：同一时刻与同一瞬间
Investigation 4: The same clock reading versus the same instant

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
北京和另一城市都显示12:00，是否在观察同一个真实瞬间？
If Beijing and another city both show 12:00, are they observing the same instant?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
使用真实日期观测，固定基准地点、日期和时刻，添加一个经度差异明显的城市。先不改变原观测地点。
Use real-date observation. Fix the baseline place, date and clock and add a city at a clearly different longitude without moving the baseline observer.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 选择固定当地真太阳时，比较两地相同太阳钟读数下的高度。
Choose equal apparent solar time and compare altitudes at equal solar clock readings.
切换为固定同一瞬间UTC，观察对照城市的当地真太阳时及必要时的日期变化。
Switch to one UTC instant and examine the comparison city’s apparent solar time and possible date rollover.
将经度滑条移到日期变更线两侧，记录日期和太阳高度，保持纬度不变。
Move longitude to either side of the date line and record dates and altitudes while keeping latitude fixed.
选中一个城市，在各图核对同色突出项；只有确实要改变基准时才使用设为基准地点。
Select a city and follow its highlighted references across views; use Make baseline only when you intend to move the primary observer.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
相同当地真太阳时通常对应不同UTC瞬间；相同UTC瞬间在不同经度可有不同当地真太阳时，甚至不同日期。
Equal apparent solar clock readings generally refer to different UTC instants. One UTC instant can have different local solar times and even different dates.
怎样解释
How to explain it
经度决定相对太阳子午圈的方向。这里的真太阳时不是手机的法定时区时间；夏令时、行政时区和均时差需要分别说明。

Longitude controls orientation relative to the solar meridian. Apparent solar time is not necessarily a phone’s civil time; administrative time zones, daylight saving and the equation of time are distinct issues.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
画出一个两列记录表，分别标记固定UTC和固定真太阳时，不能只写同一时间。
Make a two-column record explicitly labeled fixed UTC and fixed apparent solar time rather than simply same time.

title: 任务五：杆高、影长与影尖轨迹
Investigation 5: Rod height, shadow length and shadow-tip paths

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
影子为什么改变方向和长度？提高杆高会改变太阳高度吗？
Why does a shadow change direction and length? Does a taller rod change solar altitude?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
固定地点、日期和地面，先使用竖直杆。水平地面上的影长关系适用于太阳在地平线上方且杆竖直的情况。
Fix place, date and the ground, starting with a vertical rod. The horizontal-ground shadow-length relation applies when the Sun is above the horizon and the rod is vertical.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 打开俯视日影，观察09:00、12:00、15:00的影长和方向。
Open the overhead shadow view and inspect shadow length and direction at 09:00, 12:00 and 15:00.
开启影尖轨迹，再调节显示放大倍率；分清改变显示倍率与改变杆高。
Show the shadow-tip path and change display magnification, distinguishing magnification from rod height.
进入搭建实验，放置两根不同高度的竖杆，保持位置和倾斜规则明确；用测量工具比较。
Build two vertical rods of different heights with explicit positions and constraints, then compare using measurement tools.
改变日期并保留一个参考，比较影尖轨迹；太阳接近地平线时单独记录显示范围的限制。
Keep a reference and change the date to compare paths; separately record display limits near the horizon.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
影子方向与太阳水平投影相反。相同太阳高度下，竖直杆的影长与杆高成比例；夜间不应有直射阳光产生的地面影子。

A shadow points opposite the Sun’s horizontal projection. For vertical rods at one solar altitude, shadow length is proportional to rod height; at night no direct-sunlight ground shadow should appear.
怎样解释
How to explain it
太阳高度为h、杆高为H时，平地影长L=H/tan(h)。h接近0°时影长很大，画面裁剪不意味着影子真的终止在边缘。
For altitude h and vertical height H, horizontal shadow length is L=H/tan(h). The length becomes very large near h=0°; canvas clipping does not physically end a shadow.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
分别说明改变杆高、相机缩放、显示倍率会改变什么，并解释为什么不能用截断影子验证公式。
State what rod height, camera zoom and display magnification each change, and explain why a clipped shadow cannot validate the formula.

title: 任务六：日晷为什么可以计时？
Investigation 6: Why can a sundial tell time?

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
水平日晷和赤道日晷为何采用不同的刻度布局？
Why do horizontal and equatorial sundials use different hour markings?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
进入观测条件中的日晷相关控件或日晷网址，固定地点与日期，区分太阳时刻度与带固定时区偏移的钟表时解释。
Open the sundial controls or the sundial URL. Fix place and date and distinguish solar-time markings from interpretations using a fixed civil offset.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 分别观察水平式与赤道式，识别晷针、晷面与地轴的关系。
Inspect horizontal and equatorial versions and identify the gnomon, dial plane and rotation axis.
在几个整点暂停，比较影线与时刻标记；记录不能得到有效交点的情形。
Pause at several whole hours and compare shadow lines with hour markings, recording cases without a valid intersection.
只改变纬度，观察水平日晷刻度和晷针方向怎样变化。
Change latitude alone and observe changes in the horizontal dial and gnomon orientation.
切换到另一季节，检查赤道晷面受光的正反面及日照可用性。
Change the season and inspect which side of the equatorial plane is illuminated and whether direct sunlight is available.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
水平式刻度通常不等距；赤道式利用与地球自转轴垂直的平面表达时角。不同装置的刻度不能直接混用。
Horizontal hour markings are generally unequal; an equatorial plane represents hour angle around the rotation axis. The markings cannot be interchanged between designs.
怎样解释
How to explain it
装置几何决定光线与晷面的交点。太阳时、钟表时和经度改正不同，模型设置的固定偏移不自动处理夏令时。
The apparatus geometry determines ray–plane intersections. Solar time, civil time and longitude corrections differ, and a fixed offset does not automatically handle daylight saving.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
指出至少两个导致实物日晷读数与手机时间不同的原因。
Give at least two reasons why a physical sundial may disagree with a phone clock.

title: 任务七：月相与月球的升落
Investigation 7: Moon phases and lunar rising and setting

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
月相变化与月球一天内在天空中的运动，是同一件事吗？
Are lunar phase changes the same process as daily motion across the sky?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
选择月相模式和一个真实日期，先固定时刻按日观察月相，再固定日期观察日内位置。
Choose Moon mode and a real date. First hold the clock fixed and step through dates to study phase, then hold a date fixed to study daily position.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 将月相与关系、照明比例、月出月落和天空视图放在一起。
Combine phase relationships, illumination, lunar rise/set and the sky view.
逐日记录月面照明比例、相位位置和可见亮面朝向。
Record illumination, orbital phase position and the visible bright-limb orientation on successive dates.
返回一个日期，拖动日内时刻，比较月球高度变化及月出月落事件。
Return to one date, scrub through the day and compare lunar altitude with rise/set events.
拖动升落事件点，观察系统反求附近日期，说明这次操作改变了日期，而不是随意旋转方位盘。
Drag a rise/set marker and observe the date search, identifying the changed date rather than interpreting the interaction as free compass rotation.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
月相主要由日地月相对几何决定。当天可能只有月出或只有月落事件；月球并不保证每天在相同钟点出现。
Phase mainly reflects Sun–Earth–Moon geometry. A calendar day may contain only a rise or only a set; the Moon does not recur at a fixed clock time each day.
怎样解释
How to explain it
月球亮面方向还与本地朝向和观察视角有关。月相示意中的距离和大小可能经过教学放大，不能据此判断日月食。
Bright-limb orientation also depends on local orientation and viewpoint. Teaching-scale sizes and distances in a phase diagram cannot establish eclipses.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
用两组记录分别解释月相月周期和一天内高度变化，并指出二者各自应固定哪些条件。
Use separate records to explain monthly phase variation and daily altitude change, naming the controls held fixed in each.

title: 任务八：行星伴月与角距离
Investigation 8: Planet–Moon comparisons and angular separation

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
天空中看起来靠近的两个天体，在空间中也一定靠近吗？
Do two objects that look close in the sky have to be close in space?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
固定地点和真实日期，选择月球与一个行星。角距离是两条视线夹角，不是公里距离。
Fix place and real date and choose the Moon and a planet. Angular separation is an angle between sight lines, not a distance in kilometers.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 打开行星伴月或仰望天空，选择比较行星，并确认两者是否都位于地平线上方。
Open Moon & planets or Looking up, select a planet and verify whether both objects are above the horizon.
按日调整日期，记录角距离；若使用搜索，先读清地点、时间和搜索日期范围。
Step dates and record separation; when searching, check the observer, time basis and date range first.
用时间标记或位置记录保留结果；转头寻找天体时不要同时移动观测地点。
Keep markers or position records, and do not move the actual observer while merely turning the camera.
打开三维太阳系核对两颗天体的空间位置，解释投影接近与真实距离的区别。
Check spatial positions in the 3D Solar System and distinguish projected proximity from physical distance.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
角距离小只表示天空中的方向接近。低于地平线、夜间条件或真实能见度仍影响实地观察。
Small angular separation means similar sky directions. Horizon position, darkness and real observing conditions still affect visibility.
怎样解释
How to explain it
仰望画面是当地天空方向投影，三维太阳系则是经过比例处理的空间示意；两者可以相互解释，但读数不能混用。

The local-sky display projects viewing directions, while the 3D Solar System is a scale-adjusted spatial illustration. They complement each other but their displayed distances are not interchangeable.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
解释一次伴月搜索结果不能保证肉眼可见，并写出还需核对的观测条件。
Explain why a search result does not guarantee naked-eye visibility and list additional observing conditions to check.

title: 任务九：日行迹为什么像“8”字？
Investigation 9: Why can the analemma look like a figure eight?

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
每天同一个钟点记录太阳，为什么不只得到一条南北方向的线？
Why does the Sun recorded at one civil clock time each day not trace only a north–south line?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
选择真实日期、固定地点，并把日行迹采样依据设为固定钟表时；明确UTC固定偏移。全年采样时刻与下方当前观测时刻是两套不同控制。
Use real dates and a fixed place. Set the annual sampling basis to a fixed civil clock with an explicit UTC offset. Annual sample time and the current observation clock are separate controls.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 打开日行迹，记录全年曲线的上下范围、左右变化及当前日期点。
Open Analemma and inspect vertical extent, horizontal variation and the current date marker.
只改变全年固定采样时刻，观察曲线在当地天空中的位置变化。
Change only the fixed annual sampling time and inspect the resulting position in the local sky.
改用固定真太阳时，或勾选跟随下方真太阳时，比较均时差所致的左右分量。
Switch to apparent solar time or link to the lower apparent-solar clock and compare the horizontal equation-of-time component.
在理想成因实验中分别调整地轴倾角和轨道偏心率，每次只改一项，再与真实日期模式比较。
In the idealized cause experiment, vary axial tilt and orbital eccentricity separately, then compare with real-date mode.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
真实钟表时采样同时包含赤纬变化和均时差影响。固定真太阳时会去掉由均时差引起的时角左右变化，但不同投影仍可能产生几何弯曲。

Fixed civil-clock sampling combines declination changes with the equation of time. Fixed apparent solar time removes the corresponding hour-angle variation, although different projections can still produce geometric curvature.
怎样解释
How to explain it
地轴倾斜与轨道非圆共同影响太阳在固定钟表时的方向。理想成因模型用于隔离变量，不等同于真实星历的另一种显示皮肤。
Axial tilt and a noncircular orbit affect the direction at a fixed civil clock time. The ideal model isolates causes; it is not merely a different visual style for the real ephemeris.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
在记录表中明确写出采样依据、UTC偏移、采样时刻、地点与模型模式，缺一项就难以复现实验。
Record sampling basis, UTC offset, sample clock, location and model mode; omitting any of them makes reproduction difficult.

title: 任务十：月球上为什么有地升地落？
Investigation 10: Why does Earth rise and set above the Moon?

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
绕月飞行时看到的地升，是否等于站在固定月面上每天看到地球升起？
Is orbital Earthrise equivalent to seeing Earth rise daily from a fixed lunar site?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
在月相模式进入地升地落。这里是独立的圆轨道教学模型，绕月角度、飞行速度和日地月构型由本模块控制，不由下方真实日期星历直接决定。
In Moon mode open Earthrise. This independent circular-orbit lesson controls orbital angle, flight speed and Sun–Earth–Moon configuration separately from the lower real-date ephemeris clock.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 选择绕月观察，点击看地升；同时看轨道示意中的观察位置和宇航员视角。
Choose orbital observation and Watch Earthrise, comparing the orbit diagram with the astronaut view.
暂停并拖动绕月位置，说明月面边缘如何遮住或露出地球。
Pause and change orbital position, explaining how the lunar limb hides or reveals Earth.
改变高度，比较地平线下俯和地球出现位置；若地球离开画面，使用朝向地球。
Change altitude and compare horizon depression and emergence; use Look toward Earth if Earth leaves the view.
切到固定月面模式，再改变构型，比较地球方向与亮面变化。
Switch to a fixed surface site and change the configuration, comparing Earth’s direction with its illuminated fraction.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
绕月运动改变视线与月面边缘的关系。固定近地侧月面在同步自转简化模型中不会每天看到地球升落；地球亮面仍可变化。

Orbital motion changes the sight line relative to the lunar limb. At a fixed near-side site in this synchronous-rotation model, Earth does not rise and set daily, although its illuminated fraction can vary.
怎样解释
How to explain it
模块未模拟真实月球天平动、地形遮挡和精确任务轨迹；不能把教学飞行速度当作真实轨道周期。
The lesson omits lunar libration, terrain and precise mission trajectories. Animation speed is not the physical orbital period.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
画出观察者、月球边缘和地球的视线关系，并解释转头、绕月移动和改变光照构型分别改变什么。
Sketch the observer–limb–Earth sight line and distinguish turning the camera, moving in orbit and changing illumination geometry.

title: 任务十一：用空间模型解释天空视运动
Investigation 11: Explain apparent motion using a spatial model

text: 探究问题
Inquiry question
日心空间位置、地球观察方向与当地天空读数怎样联系？
How are heliocentric positions, Earth-based directions and local-sky readings connected?
先固定条件
Fix these conditions first
进入三维天空，固定日期；读取时间栏的UTC标注。天体大小、行星轨道距离和月地距离采用不同教学显示尺度。
Open 3D Sky and fix a date, noting the UTC label. Body sizes, planetary orbital distances and Moon–Earth distances use different teaching scales.
操作与记录
Procedure and recording

items: 在太阳系总览中选取地球及另一颗行星，比较说明中的物理量与图中显示尺寸。
Select Earth and another planet in the overview and distinguish physical values in the facts panel from displayed sizes.
切换日地月关系，识别太阳方向、月球照明和地球姿态。
Switch to Sun–Earth–Moon relationships and identify sunlight, lunar illumination and Earth’s orientation.
打开原图对照或当地观察相关视图，核对同一UTC瞬间的太阳或月球方向。
Open the diagram comparison or local observer view and cross-check directions at the same UTC instant.
使用参考平面、距离线、角度弧或说明标签表达证据；涉及额外天体时读清其模型和显示范围。
Use reference planes, distance lines, angle arcs or labels as evidence, checking model and display limits for additional populations.

text: 应观察到什么
What to look for
相机旋转不改变物理位置。显示距离可被压缩，但物理向量和读数仍采用各自标明的单位。
Camera rotation does not change physical positions. Display distances can be compressed while physical vectors and readings retain their stated units.
怎样解释
How to explain it
从空间位置转换到当地天空，需要考虑观测者位置、地球姿态和坐标投影；不能仅凭三维画面上的两点距离判断天空角距离。
Converting spatial positions to local sky directions requires the observer, Earth orientation and projection; separation between rendered points is not itself sky angular separation.
检查是否理解
Check understanding
说明一个模型有意夸大的量和一个仍由真实星历计算的量，并说明用途不同。
Identify one deliberately exaggerated display quantity and one quantity computed from the ephemeris, explaining their different purposes.

text: 教师可以让学生交换完整实验和文字记录，互相复现实验后再讨论分歧。网页收藏不自动跨设备同步，因此共享时还要提供操作条件、截图或可用的对象导出文件。

text: 视图目录按天空与日影、关联图解、全年变化、对照与搭建分组。空间视图、俯视日影、地平视角和仰望天空位于左侧“天空与日影”内部，月球模式显示对应视角；画布上方不再重复这些按钮。组合图的“编辑”入口放在各图标题栏，避免遮住数据和操作提示。普通模式也能打开组合视图；调整内容和排列需要进入自定义。

The view catalog groups Sky & shadows, Related diagrams, Annual changes and Compare & build. Spatial view, shadow plan view, horizon view and look-up view are nested under Sky & shadows in the left sidebar; Moon mode uses its corresponding viewpoints. These controls are not duplicated above the canvas. In combinations, each pane’s Edit action lives in its header so data and gesture hints remain unobstructed. Combined views also work in normal mode; customization enables composition changes.

items: 点击图名打开单图。组合中点击已显示图名会选中对应图位，点击未显示图名会替换当前图位。
A view name opens a single view. In a combination, an included name selects its pane and an absent name replaces the active pane.
先点要操作的图窗，看绿色边框与左侧对应项；此后替换操作针对这个图位。
Click the intended pane and check its green outline and matching catalog item; replacements target this pane.
图名右侧的加入控件新增一个图位；已加入时变为移除。至少保留一张图。
The control beside a name adds a pane; for an included view it removes it. At least one pane remains.
天空图只有一个目录入口；空间视图、俯视日影、地平视角和仰望天空集中在天空图标题栏。
Sky has one catalog entry. Spatial, overhead-shadow, horizon and looking-up viewpoints are grouped in the sky pane header.

text: 不是每个独立模块都能嵌入组合。目录中有加入控件的内容才支持加入；地升地落和搭建保留独立场景。
Only entries offering an add control support composition. Earthrise and construction retain their independent scenes.

title: 太阳与日影的四个视角
Four Sun and shadow viewpoints

text: 四个视角共享基准地点、日期和时刻。改变视角不应改变这些科学条件。
The four viewpoints share the baseline location, date and clock; switching viewpoints does not change them.

items: 空间视图：拖动旋转相机，滚轮或双指缩放，使用复位视角恢复；查看日轨迹、杆和影子。
Spatial view: drag the camera, scroll or pinch to zoom and use Reset view. Inspect the daily path, rod and shadow.
俯视日影：从地面上方比较影长、方向和影尖轨迹；显示放大倍率只影响画面尺度。
Overhead shadow: compare length, direction and tip paths from above; display magnification changes the display scale only.
地平视角：从地平线附近看升落和高度变化，注意虚线表示地平线下的延伸。
Horizon view: inspect rising, setting and altitude changes, noting dashed below-horizon extensions.
仰望天空：转动朝向寻找太阳、月球或行星。转头不同于改变观测地点。
Looking up: turn toward the Sun, Moon or planets. Turning the view is different from relocating the observer.

text: 显示辅助中的轨迹、角度线、影子、影尖记录和月球叠加按当前模式提供。夜间、极昼、极夜或太阳近地平线时，某些影子读数可能不存在或超出画面。

Display aids offer tracks, angle references, shadows, tip traces and lunar overlays where supported. At night, during polar conditions or close to the horizon, shadow readings may be absent or extend beyond the canvas.

title: 地球与昼夜、地图和地轴图
Earth, daylight, maps and axis geometry

text: 地球与昼夜连接太阳方向、直射点、观察地点与昼夜分布；地轴与地平面图连接地轴、赤道面和当地地平面。
Earth & daylight connects sunlight, the subsolar point, observer and day–night pattern. Axis & horizon connects the rotation axis, equator and local horizon.

items: 在球面视图与全球平面图间选择。球面拖动默认可以只旋转视角，先检查拖动规则。
Choose globe or world map and check the drag rule before interacting; a globe gesture can rotate only the view.
使用取动观测地点或拖动明确的观察点移动地点；选择固定同一UTC瞬间或固定当地真太阳时。
Use the explicit observer-move mode or observer marker, choosing fixed UTC or fixed apparent solar time.
需要只改纬度或经度时使用移动约束；对准观察地点用于调整相机朝向。
Use movement constraints to change only latitude or longitude. Align observer location changes the camera orientation.
在地轴图拖动相机核对不同平面关系；用图例识别地轴、赤道面、地平面、天顶和太阳方向。
Rotate the axis view and use its legend to distinguish axis, equator, horizon, zenith and sunlight.

text: 太阳模式横轴是当地真太阳时，纵轴是太阳高度；月球照明图采用另一种横纵轴，不能直接混用。
The solar chart uses apparent solar time horizontally and altitude vertically. The lunar illumination chart has different axes.

items: 沿曲线点选时刻，与下方公共时间栏和天空中的当前位置互相核对。
Select a time on the curve and cross-check the lower clock and current sky position.
在自定义里添加日期对照曲线，用该对象自己的日期滑条或日历改变参考日期。
Add a date comparison curve in customization and change its reference date using the object’s own slider or calendar.
添加水平参考线、时刻标记或两点时间与高度差测量，读清起止点和单位。
Add horizontal levels, time markers or two-point time/altitude differences and check endpoints and units.
比较曲线峰值、过零、全天高于零或低于零的情况；重合曲线可能来自相同条件。
Compare peaks, zero crossings and curves wholly above or below zero. Identical conditions may produce overlapping curves.

title: 日出日落与月出月落方位
Solar and lunar rise/set bearings

text: 事件按天体中心穿越几何地平线计算，不包含大气折射、山地遮挡或太阳视半径修正。方向基准固定，不通过旋转盘面伪造新读数。

Events use the body center crossing the geometric horizon, without atmospheric refraction, terrain or solar-radius corrections. Cardinal directions stay fixed rather than rotating to fabricate readings.

items: 点击出或落的端点，跳到相应事件时刻。
Click a rise or set endpoint to jump to that event time.
按住端点拖向另一个方位，系统保持地点不变并反求能接近目标的日期，各图与下方日期同时更新。
Drag an endpoint toward another bearing. The site stays fixed while the date is searched, updating other views and the shared date.
太阳在当前年份内寻找日期，月球在原日期前后五周内寻找；超出可实现范围时停在最近结果并提示。
Solar dates are searched within the current year, lunar dates within five weeks of the original date. Unreachable targets use the nearest achievable result with an explanation.
左右键按日调日期；滚轮或双指缩放；Home复位缩放；拖动中Esc取消并恢复原日期。
Left/Right changes date by a day; scroll or pinch zooms; Home resets zoom; Escape cancels a drag and restores its starting date.

text: 没有当天事件时没有可拖端点。应先用日期和地点控制寻找有事件的条件。极点不赋予唯一升落方位。
No endpoint is draggable if that event is absent. Use date or location controls first. At a pole the model does not assign a unique bearing.

title: 月相、照明比例和行星伴月
Phases, illumination and Moon–planet comparisons

text: 切到月相后，系统保留太阳与月球各自设置，并在视图目录提供适合月球的内容。
Moon mode retains separate solar and lunar settings and offers lunar-specific views in the catalog.

items: 月相与关系：观察日地月位置、地球视角亮面和月球轨道相位。
Phase relationships: inspect Sun–Earth–Moon geometry, the Earth-based bright portion and orbital phase.
逐日照明比例：按日期比较月面照明比例，用当前日期点核对月相图。
Daily illumination: compare illuminated fraction over dates and cross-check the current date with the phase diagram.
月出月落：读取该日一个或两个事件，缺少事件不一定是异常。
Moonrise/set: inspect the day’s events; a missing rise or set can be valid.
行星伴月：选择行星、检查角距离和地平线位置，使用日期范围搜索时保留其地点和时间依据。
Moon & planets: select a planet, check separation and horizon position, and preserve the observer and time basis for range searches.

text: 伴月表示方向接近，不是物理碰撞或实际距离接近。搜索结果也不包含天气、地形、背景亮度和目视极限的完整评估。
A close approach is directional, not a collision or necessarily close physical spacing. Search results do not fully assess weather, terrain, sky brightness or visual detection limits.
在月相模式从关联图解进入地升地落。轨道示意和宇航员视角使用同一个绕月状态；本模块不把实验台日期当作真实月球任务轨道。
Open Earthrise through Related diagrams in Moon mode. The orbital diagram and astronaut view share one orbital state; the module does not treat the Lab date as a real mission trajectory.

items: 选择绕月观察或固定月面。绕月模式可调位置角、高度、飞行时长和日地月构型。
Choose orbit or fixed surface. Orbit mode adjusts position angle, altitude, animation duration and Sun–Earth–Moon configuration.
点击看地升找到地球从月面边缘出现的位置，再播放或暂停。
Use Watch Earthrise to find emergence at the lunar limb, then play or pause.
地球在画面外时使用朝向地球或Home；拖动宇航员画面只是转头。
Use Look toward Earth or Home when Earth is off screen; dragging the astronaut view turns the head only.
手机可切换轨道图和宇航员视图；仍从左侧视图与布局返回其他模块，观测条件栏调本模块参数。
On phones switch between orbital and astronaut views. Use Views & layout to leave the module and Observation controls for its parameters.

text: 固定月面模式禁用绕月位置、高度和飞行播放等不适用控制。模型采用同步自转、球面月球与圆轨道，未模拟天平动和真实地形。
Fixed-surface mode disables inapplicable orbital angle, altitude and flight controls. The model uses synchronous rotation, a spherical Moon and a circular orbit without libration or terrain.
日行迹显示同一地点全年在固定采样时刻的太阳方向。标题栏标明采样时刻与依据，下方公共时间栏显示当前观察条件。
The analemma records solar direction through a year at a fixed sample clock for one site. Its header labels sampling time and basis; the lower timeline retains current observing conditions.

items: 选择当地天空三维示意、天空坐标或赤纬与时角等可用投影。
Choose an available projection such as the local 3D sky, sky coordinates or declination/hour angle.
设置全年采样时刻、固定钟表时或固定真太阳时，以及钟表时的UTC固定偏移。
Set the annual sample clock, fixed civil or apparent-solar basis and the fixed UTC offset for civil time.
需要与公共时刻联动时勾选跟随真太阳时；手动改采样时刻或依据会解除该联动。
Link to the shared apparent-solar clock when needed; changing sample time or basis unlinks it.
叠加不同固定时刻、地点或参考轨迹；小画幅会减少月份文字，当前月份优先。
Overlay clocks, sites or reference tracks. Small panes reduce month labels and prioritize the current month.
成因实验独立调整地轴倾角和轨道偏心率；完成后回到真实日期模式再解释真实星历。
In the cause experiment, vary tilt and eccentricity independently, then return to real-date mode before interpreting the ephemeris.

text: 日晷相关页面和实验台控制提供杆影、水平式与赤道式装置。它们与教学图解共享地点和太阳方向，但显示缩放不等于改变装置尺寸。

Sundial pages and Lab controls provide rod shadows and horizontal/equatorial apparatus. They share location and sunlight with teaching diagrams, while display scaling is distinct from physical dimensions.

items: 先选择装置或日影视图，再设置纬度、日期、时刻和杆高等适用参数。
Choose apparatus or shadow view, then set applicable latitude, date, clock and rod height.
比较轨道、俯视、影尖轨迹或装置视角，使用复位恢复相机。
Compare orbit, overhead, tip-path or apparatus viewpoints and reset the camera when needed.
核对太阳时和固定时区偏移的读数说明，不把晷面刻度自动解释为本地法定时间。
Check solar-time and fixed-offset explanations rather than assuming civil local time.
太阳低于地平线或光线与晷面无有效交点时，按提示判断可用性，不强求一个读数。
When the Sun is below the horizon or no valid ray–plane intersection exists, use the status instead of expecting a reading.

title: 进入自定义与对象编辑
Customization and object editing

text: 统一开关位于顶部语言按钮旁；进入后保留原观测控制，并启用图中对象、加入或移除图位、布局编辑和搭建工具。不会自动放入一个未说明的参考圈。

The common switch sits beside language. Entering preserves original observation controls and enables references, composition changes, layout editing and construction. No unexplained reference circle is automatically added.

items: 先选需要的图，再从图中对象点击添加对象；使用目标任务的快捷方案，或展开自由工具。
Choose the relevant view, open Plot objects and Add objects, then use a goal-based recipe or advanced tools.
需要点选位置的工具会给出放置提示；在图上点击，或使用可用的放在中央操作。
Placement tools provide a hint; click the plot or use the available center-placement action.
选择列表或图中对象后，在属性中用滑条预览、用输入框精调；对象的显隐与锁定控制分别管理。
Select a row or plotted reference and use sliders or precise inputs. Visibility and locking are separate controls.
每行更多菜单提供适用的保存、复制、删除；撤销和重做管理对象操作。连续滑条拖动合并为一步，Esc取消正在进行的操作。
Each row’s More menu offers applicable save, duplicate and delete actions. Undo/redo handles reference edits; a continuous slider drag is grouped, and Escape cancels an active gesture.
完成自定义保留当前组合，隐藏编辑把手；再次进入可继续编辑。刷新默认回到普通模式，草稿按会话规则恢复。
Finishing retains the composition and hides editing handles. Re-enter to continue. Refresh starts in normal mode, with drafts restored according to session rules.

rows: 观察城市、纬度和经度参考、太阳方向、说明与重点标记
Observer sites, latitude/longitude guides, Sun directions, notes and emphasis
日期曲线、水平高度线、时刻标记、两点时间与高度差
Date curves, altitude levels, clock markers and time/altitude differences
方位圈、遮挡或参考高度、日期事件标记和测量
Bearing circles, obstruction/reference levels, dated event markers and measurements
观察者、参考圈、方向、轴面显隐与夹角
Observers, circles, directions, plane/axis visibility and angles
观察位置、视线、光线、相位标记与快照
Observer positions, sight lines, rays, phase markers and snapshots
比较天体、角距离、日期与位置轨迹
Comparison objects, angular separation, dates and position trails
地点或时刻轨迹、参考高度与方向、日期标签
Site/clock tracks, altitude/direction guides and date labels
参考平面、相机位置、距离线、角度弧和说明
Reference planes, camera markers, distance lines, angle arcs and notes

text: 实际工具按当前图、天体和模式筛选，不是每张图都有同一组工具。轨迹对象、快照和观察站的含义也以当前图的说明为准。
Tools are filtered by view, body and mode; not every plot offers the same set. Tracks, snapshots and observer stations have view-specific meanings.
对照对象附加在基准实验之上。添加城市不会自动移动原观测地点；相同条件的两条曲线可能完全重合。
Comparison references are added to the baseline experiment. Adding a city does not relocate the baseline, and identical conditions can produce overlapping curves.

items: 同一瞬间不同地点：从添加对象的地点任务选城市并开始；默认按同一UTC瞬间比较。
Different places at one instant: choose a city in the place recipe and start, using the shared UTC instant.
选择城市后拖动经纬度；离开预设坐标时自动名称改为自定义地点与坐标，手动命名保持不变。
Scrub coordinates after selecting the city. Leaving preset coordinates updates an automatic name to a custom location; a manual name remains.
在固定UTC与固定当地真太阳时间选择实验依据；跨午夜时读清对照的当地日期。
Choose fixed UTC or equal apparent solar time and check local dates across midnight.
选中城市后，各相关图的同一对象突出，其他对照淡化；用设为基准地点才改变原地点。
Selecting a city emphasizes it across related views and dims others; Make baseline explicitly relocates the primary observer.
同地不同时刻方案可加入早晚标记；用对象时间滑条调整。日期曲线则使用自己的日期，不改公共日期。
The same-place recipe adds earlier/later clock markers with their own slider. Date curves use their own dates without changing the shared date.

text: 独立的地点与时间对照场景还可一次显示当前与前后时刻，或当前与两个对照地点；时间间隔、参考地点和读数由该场景的观测条件管理。
The dedicated place/time scene can show the current and surrounding clocks or the baseline and two comparison locations, with interval, sites and readings in its observation controls.

title: 搭建杆、球、圈与测量
Construct rods, spheres, circles and measurements

text: 搭建实验从空白地面或明确标识的已存场景开始。太阳与月球拥有独立的物体场景；地面是教学模型，不是任意真实地形模拟。
Construction starts with empty ground or an explicitly restored scene. Sun and Moon use separate object scenes; the ground is a teaching model rather than arbitrary terrain.

items: 选择杆、球、参考圈、平面、刻度盘、观察站、标记点或文字，再点击地面放置；可一次添加多个。
Choose a rod, sphere, circle, plane, dial, station, marker or note and click the ground; multiple items can be placed at once.
用属性滑条调整位置、尺寸、高度、方向和允许的倾斜。先检查保持竖直、贴合地面、锁定与网格吸附。
Adjust position, dimensions, elevation, direction and permitted tilt, checking upright, grounded, locked and grid-snap constraints.
使用圆周、等距、对齐等适用排列；多选后读清对整组或单个物体的操作范围。
Use applicable circular, equally spaced or aligned arrangements and check whether operations target one object or a group.
选择相应物体建立距离、角度或影长测量；记录运动时检查轨迹长度和样本范围。
Choose the required objects for distance, angle or shadow measurements and check trail length and sampling when recording motion.
保留一份场景参考，再只改变一个条件进行对照；增加文字说明记录实验假设。
Keep a reference scene and change one condition for comparison, adding notes to record assumptions.

text: 改变相机不会移动物体。约束会限制可编辑范围；被锁定的物体不能直接拖走。月球光照与日影相关读数应按当前模式说明理解。
Camera changes do not relocate objects. Constraints limit edits, and locked objects cannot be dragged. Interpret lunar lighting and shadow readings according to the current mode.
多图工作区复用同一批科学画布和一个公共时间栏。最多可以容纳六张适合组合的图；超过四张时纵向滚动，手机通过图名标签切换。
The multi-view workspace reuses scientific canvases and one shared clock. Up to six composable views are supported; more than four scroll vertically, while phones switch through view tabs.

items: 进入自定义后，从目录加入图；排列与收藏中选择一至四图的快捷数量或常用组合。
Enter customization and add views from the catalog; use count presets or quick combinations in Arrangement & saved layouts.
两图可左右并排或上下排列；三图可均衡或主辅布局。拖动把手交换顺序，或使用顺序按钮。
Two views can be side by side or stacked, and three can be balanced or featured. Reorder by handles or order controls.
拖动分隔线预览比例，松手更新画布；精确输入比例允许30%至70%，确认后应用。
Drag dividers to preview proportions and release to resize the canvases, or commit an exact proportion from 30% to 70%.
点击专注此图临时放大；Esc返回组合。撤销与重做布局不等于撤销科学条件。
Focus a pane temporarily and press Escape to return. Layout undo/redo is separate from scientific-condition history.

text: 添加图解只有目录中的一个入口；收藏栏不再重复列出一套添加按钮。完成自定义后保留组合，但隐藏编辑把手和分隔线。
The catalog is the single add-view entry; saved-layout settings do not repeat those buttons. Finishing retains the composition while hiding editing handles and dividers.
保存范围分为会话草稿、独立对象或场景存档、布局收藏和完整实验。先选对范围，再判断刷新或换设备后是否还能恢复。
Storage covers session drafts, individual reference/scene saves, layout collections and full experiments. Choose the scope before relying on refresh or another device.

items: 只收藏排列：打开排列与收藏，保持连同观测与对象保存未勾选，命名后保存组合。
For layout only, leave Include conditions and objects off in Arrangement & saved layouts, enter a name and save.
保存完整实验：勾选该选项，命名后保存；它包括观测状态、布局、当前天体的图中对象和搭建物体。
For a full experiment, select the option and save a name; this includes observation state, layout, current-body references and construction objects.
点击带完整实验标记的收藏恢复。恢复后暂停播放；无效的完整记录会拒绝应用，不部分覆盖当前实验。
Select a save marked Full experiment to restore it paused. Invalid full records are rejected without partially replacing the current experiment.
收藏可重命名、用当前内容更新或删除，最多五项；同名保存用于更新。对象行的独立保存和搭建场景保存仍保留。
Up to five saves can be renamed, updated or removed; reusing a name updates it. Individual reference and ground-scene saves remain available.
跨设备分享时同时提供文字条件和可用的对象JSON导出；不要把浏览器本地收藏当作云账号同步。
For another device, provide written conditions and available object JSON exports rather than assuming cloud-account synchronization.

Reference edits and experiment state within the session
关页、存储限制和跨页面行为以提示为准
Subject to session lifetime, storage limits and page behavior
图的种类、顺序、排列与比例
不改变日期地点等科学条件

title: 共享科学状态的完整变量表
Complete shared-state dictionary

text: initialSun是太阳默认状态；initialMoon继承它并覆盖月球字段。modeStates.sun与modeStates.moon分别保留模式状态，state指向当前活动对象。切换天体应切换该引用，而不是把两种天体的播放设置混写。

initialSun defines solar defaults. initialMoon inherits them and overrides lunar fields. modeStates.sun and modeStates.moon retain separate mode state, and state points to the active object. Switching bodies should switch the reference rather than mixing playback settings.

Minutes after midnight, not Unix milliseconds

Absent crossing; distinct from minute zero

跨模块传参前显式换算

text: 不要把屏幕像素、归一化地面坐标、Three.js显示单位与物理长度混用。局部函数中的w、h通常是CSS像素尺寸，dpr是像素密度；物理向量必须另存，不能被压缩显示坐标覆盖。

Do not mix pixels, normalized ground coordinates, Three.js display units and physical lengths. Local w/h usually denote CSS pixels and dpr device-pixel ratio. Physical vectors must be retained separately from compressed display coordinates.
公共state.time采用当地真太阳时。sunHourAngle从太阳赤经与恒星时求时角；solarNoonUTC从经度近似出发迭代求太阳时角为0的UTC；instantUTC再迭代匹配目标时角。skyRaw把这个UTC交给Astronomy Engine求站心赤道坐标与无折射地平坐标。

Shared state.time is apparent solar time. sunHourAngle uses solar right ascension and sidereal time; solarNoonUTC starts from longitude and iterates to zero hour angle, and instantUTC iterates to the requested angle. skyRaw then uses Astronomy Engine for topocentric equatorial and unrefracted horizon coordinates.

blocks.text:
H_degrees = time_minutes / 4 - 180
UTC_target = instantUTC(time_minutes, date_YYYY_MM_DD, longitude_degrees)
position = skyRaw(body, time_minutes, date_YYYY_MM_DD, latitude, longitude)

text: 固定UTC异地比较先从基准条件求一个真实瞬间，再分别换算各地太阳钟和当地日期。固定真太阳时则对每个经度分别求UTC，因此不是同一个真实瞬间。时间偏移与跨日期换算必须保留，不允许只把小时取模后丢掉日期。

A shared-UTC comparison computes one baseline instant and derives each site’s solar clock and local date. Equal apparent solar time computes a separate UTC instant for each longitude. Preserve rollover rather than merely reducing clock hours modulo 24.
日行迹的clock依据使用固定UTC偏移的钟表时；apparent依据走instantUTC。observerTimeBasis的solar/utc与analemmaBasis的clock/apparent是不同枚举，不能因为都表示太阳时就互相赋值。三维太阳系按UTC日期运行，地升地落采用独立的绕月角和演示秒数。

The analemma clock basis uses a civil clock with a fixed UTC offset, whereas apparent uses instantUTC. observerTimeBasis solar/utc and analemmaBasis clock/apparent are different enums and must not be assigned interchangeably. The 3D Solar System runs on UTC dates; Earthrise uses independent orbital angle and animation seconds.
setDate验证公历日期和1900—2100范围，应用真实日期时关闭manual并重算太阳赤纬。日期字符串不能当作设备时区中的随意午夜；源码以明确的UTC构造保持一致。

setDate validates the calendar and 1900–2100 range, disables manual when applying a real date and recomputes declination. A date string is not an arbitrary device-zone midnight; explicit UTC construction maintains consistency.

title: 当地坐标、太阳公式与地轴关系
Local coordinates, solar equations and axis geometry

text: solar使用纬度φ、赤纬δ和时角H。输入角度先乘rad；输出方向向量为东x、上y、北z，向量在理想模型中为单位长度。
solar uses latitude φ, declination δ and hour angle H. Degree inputs are multiplied by rad. Its ideal unit vector is east x, up y and north z.

blocks.text:
x = -cos(delta) * sin(H)
y = sin(phi)*sin(delta) + cos(phi)*cos(delta)*cos(H)
z = cos(phi)*sin(delta) - sin(phi)*cos(delta)*cos(H)
alt = asin(clamp(y, -1, 1)) * deg
az = (atan2(x, z) * deg + 360) % 360

text: skyRaw返回相同当地接口，但数值来自真实日期站心星历。不要把理想公式与真实星历输出逐项强制设成一样；它们用于不同模式。coverage.js中的地轴图使用地表法向、当地北向和东向基向量，将当地太阳方向映射到地球示意。

skyRaw exposes the same local interface but uses real-date topocentric astronomy. Do not force ideal and ephemeris outputs to match component by component: they serve different modes. Axis geometry uses surface normal, local north and east to map the Sun direction onto the Earth illustration.
horizontal方位在天顶、天底和极点附近需要额外谨慎；几何地平线不包含地形或折射。逆三角函数前必须限制舍入误差范围，缺失事件使用null，不用NaN或伪造0°。

Treat horizontal azimuth carefully near zenith, nadir and geographic poles. The geometric horizon omits terrain and refraction. Clamp rounding errors before inverse trigonometric functions and represent missing events with null rather than NaN or fabricated 0°.

title: 升落、昼长与反求日期
Rise/set, daylight and inverse date search

text: 理想daylight令a=sinφ·sinδ、b=cosφ·cosδ，检验−a/b是否在反余弦定义域内，区分普通昼夜、极昼、极夜和相切。极点的b接近0需要独立分支；相切不是穿越事件。
Ideal daylight uses a=sinφ·sinδ and b=cosφ·cosδ and checks whether −a/b lies in the arccos domain. Polar b≈0 requires a separate branch; a tangency is not a crossing.

blocks.text:
cos(H0) = -tan(phi) * tan(delta)
ordinary_daylight_minutes = 8 * acos(cos(H0)) * deg
rise = 720 - 4*H0_degrees
set  = 720 + 4*H0_degrees

text: 真实日期ephemerisDay和SkyDiagramSampling.events取样高度并细化穿越。局部极值附近要追加细化，避免漏掉短暂可见区间。真实昼长使用UTC时间间隔；timeAxisLength是太阳钟坐标上的长度，不能始终视为同一个量。

Real-date ephemerisDay and SkyDiagramSampling.events sample and refine horizon crossings. Refine near local extrema to avoid missing short visibility intervals. Physical daylight uses UTC elapsed intervals; timeAxisLength is length on the solar-clock coordinate and is not always identical.

text: 拖点修改真实日期而非直接写入az。不可达目标取有实际事件的最近候选并提示。指针移动合并到动画帧，候选事件按手势复用，不能每个像素都重建全年星历。

Dragging changes date rather than assigning az. Unreachable targets use a verified event and show a nearest-result explanation. Pointer updates coalesce into frames and candidate events are reused within the gesture rather than recomputing a year for every pixel.
对水平地面和竖杆，太阳方向的竖直分量决定影长；太阳低于地平线时不绘制直射阳光的地面影子。接近地平线时影长发散，需要裁剪显示而不是改物理结果。

For horizontal ground and a vertical rod, the vertical solar component determines shadow length. Below the horizon, direct-sunlight ground shadows are absent. Near the horizon, length diverges; clip the display rather than changing the physical result.

blocks.text:
shadow_x = -rod_height * sun_x / sun_y
shadow_z = -rod_height * sun_z / sun_y
shadow_length = rod_height / tan(altitude)

text: 水平和赤道日晷通过晷针、晷面与光线的几何求交。H表示竖直高度时不能直接拿倾斜杆总长代入水平影长公式。shadowZoom、相机zoom和真实height必须分开。

Horizontal and equatorial dials use gnomon–plane–ray intersections. Do not substitute the full length of a tilted rod for vertical height H in the horizontal-shadow formula. Keep shadowZoom, camera zoom and physical height separate.

title: 日行迹数据结构与理想模型
Analemma data and the ideal cause model

text: analemmaSample为一个日期返回UTC、时角hour、赤纬dec、均时差eot、高度alt和方位az。analemmaYear按年采样，缓存键包含地点、采样钟、依据、偏移和理想参数；改变任何科学条件应使键变化。相机变化只影响投影，不必重算星历。

analemmaSample returns UTC, hour angle, declination, equation of time, altitude and azimuth for a date. analemmaYear caches annual samples by place, clock, basis, offset and ideal parameters. Scientific changes must change the key; camera changes only affect projection.

rows: Days from J2000 and Julian centuries
平黄经、平近点角与偏近点角；内部弧度
Mean longitude, mean anomaly and eccentric anomaly in radians
可控偏心率与地轴倾角；无量纲与内部弧度
Controlled eccentricity and tilt; dimensionless and internal radians
真近点角与太阳黄经；内部弧度
True anomaly and solar longitude in radians
该理想函数内的赤经、赤纬、时角输出均为角度；不要与Astronomy Engine的赤经小时混用
This ideal function outputs right ascension, declination and hour angle in degrees; Astronomy Engine RA is in hours
当前投影命中信息与平滑日期点；不是新的物理轨道
Hit/projection state and smoothed date marker, not a new physical orbit

text: 理想成因模型用牛顿迭代解开普勒方程E−e·sinE=M，再由倾角求赤经赤纬。apparent采样用迭代匹配真太阳钟。真实模式直接调用Astronomy Engine；两套模式必须有明确UI标记。月份标签只改显示密度，不删去科学采样点。

The ideal cause model solves E−e·sinE=M by Newton iteration, then uses tilt for RA/declination. Apparent-time sampling iterates to the solar clock. Real mode calls Astronomy Engine; the UI must distinguish them. Month-label density changes do not remove scientific samples.

title: 月球星历、月相与独立地升模型

text: ui-palette.css拥有语义色变量；design-system.css将其映射到Material Design 3的md-sys-color、形状、字体与状态角色，其他UI样式消费共享角色。科学图的太阳、轨道和天体数据颜色不等同于UI选中色，不能全局替换所有蓝色像素。

ui-palette.css owns semantic colors. design-system.css maps them to Material Design 3 color, shape, typography and interaction-state roles; route styles consume those shared roles. Scientific body/track colors remain separate from UI selection.

md-sys-color-*定义主操作、选中容器、表面、文字和边界；md-sys-shape-corner-*定义共享圆角；md-sys-size-target定义桌面40px、触屏48px操作目标；md-sys-state-hover与pressed定义状态层；md-sys-motion-*定义短过渡与缓动。组件只消费这些角色，不再各自定义颜色或尺寸。普通文字字段排除range、checkbox和radio，避免把字段边框套到滑动条和开关上。中文保留SkyMotion Reading宋体，英文保留SkyMotion Charter；Material组件规范不替换既定字体。

md-sys-color-* defines primary actions, selected containers, surfaces, foregrounds and outlines. md-sys-shape-corner-* defines the shared shape scale; md-sys-size-target defines 40px desktop and 48px coarse-pointer targets. md-sys-state-hover/pressed defines state layers, and md-sys-motion-* defines duration and easing. Components consume roles instead of introducing local colors or target sizes. Text-field selectors exclude range, checkbox and radio controls so field borders cannot leak onto sliders or switches. Preserve SkyMotion Reading for Chinese and SkyMotion Charter for English; Material component roles do not replace the requested typography.
